For a new clothing store, I’d narrow the purchase shortlist to these three. All are available in India and support UPI plus cards and other checkout methods. 
IMARC Group
+1

Provider	Total cost	Availability	Cancellation / refunds	Support
Razorpay	2% + GST/transaction; ₹0 setup/AMC. Current offer: 0% platform fee for first 90 days. 
Razorpay
	Online onboarding; Shopify/e-commerce integrations	No subscription commitment; refunds can be initiated through dashboard, with applicable processing economics	Docs + merchant support
Cashfree	Promotional 0% gateway fee may apply to qualifying new merchants; otherwise get a merchant-specific quote. 
Inventiva
	Online onboarding; strong e-commerce focus	Pay-as-you-go; refunds supported, but refund processing/settlement terms should be confirmed	Merchant support + documentation
PayU	Quote-based, typically around the ~2% range depending on method/contract	Available for Indian online merchants	Pay-as-you-go; confirm refund/reversal charges in contract	Enterprise/merchant support
What I'd verify before paying/signing

UPI platform fee versus true 0-MDR.

Settlement: T+1 vs instant and its cost.

Refund/reversal charges.

Shopify/WooCommerce plugin quality.

Support SLA for payment failures.

For a new store, don't buy an annual plan upfront. Get written confirmation of the transaction rate and refund terms first.
